article.headline: VonCameron Davis scores 11 to guide Kent State to 68-52 victory over Cleveland State
article.description: — VonCameron Davis scored 11 points to help Kent State defeat Cleveland State 68-52 on Saturday night.
article.linkText: VonCameron Davis scores 11 to guide Kent State to 68-52 victory over Cleveland State

categories.description: Kent State Golden Flashes @ Cleveland State Vikings

event.description: Kent State Golden Flashes @ Cleveland State Vikings

keywords: Kent State Golden Flashes @ Cleveland State Vikings
article.story: CLEVELAND -- — VonCameron Davis scored 11 points to help Kent State defeat Cleveland State 68-52 on Saturday night. Davis also added five assists and three steals for the Golden Flashes (4-1). Anthony Morales hit three 3-pointers and scored 11. Cli'Ron Hornbeak had 10 points and shot 4 of 5 from the field. Dylan Arnett led the way for the Vikings (3-4) with 11 points, 11 rebounds and two steals. Chase Robinson added 11 points and three steals. Tahj Staveskie scored 10. Kent State took the lead with 19:47 left in the first half and did not give it up. The score was 36-29 at halftime. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
